lead: A red valgrind sweep is `ring`'s assembly or the fixture's exit status before it is your refcounts.
body: Memcheck cannot follow AES-NI masking, so a TLS `[db.main]` fixture reports `Memcheck:Cond` in `ring::aead` (`tools/valgrind.supp` holds those), and valgrind passes the exit status through, so `examples/limits.nvs` (exit 1 by design) reads as a leak without `--error-exitcode=97`. `grep -c "definitely lost"` the stderr first: `0` means neither cause is yours.
